comment: Shared test sequence for the B206mini TX (run_test_sequence.py on the Pi) and the HackRF verifier (hackrf_verify.py on the Mac). ORDER MATTERS and must be identical on both sides. rx_offset shifts the HackRF center away from the carrier (used for CW so the tone is not buried in the HackRF DC spike). checks lists which measurements are pass/fail for that test.

tests.name: cw_pulse
tests.desc: BW=0: unmodulated CW pulse at the carrier

tests.name: max_pulse_min_prf
tests.desc: Longest pulse (50 us) at min PRF

tests.name: max_prf_min_duty
tests.desc: Max PRF (2 kHz) at 1% duty (5 us pulse)

tests.name: max_duty
tests.desc: Max PRF (2 kHz) at 10% duty (50 us pulse) — heaviest case

tests.name: min_pulse
tests.desc: Shortest pulse (0.3 us, ~6 RX samples) — detection only, chirp not measurable
